ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: This is a labeled marine food web diagram. In the diagram there are plankton, shrimp, fish, seals, octopuses, and a shark in the upper right labeled “Shark”. Multiple arrows point from other animals to the shark, indicating that the shark preys on other animals. Reasoning: The question asks “Which is a carnivore?” carnivore refers to an animal that eats other animals. The shark in the diagram is located at a higher position in the food web, and other animals point to it, showing that it eats animals, so it is a carnivorous animal.
